title: Observability: Cloud Monitoring, Logging, Trace & Profiler — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes Google Cloud Observability architecture: details OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Cloud Monitoring MQL metrics, Cloud Logging log routing sinks, Cloud Trace distributed spans, and Cloud Profiler continuous CPU/heap profiling.
routing_rationale: Observability decouples telemetry collection from application execution. OpenTelemetry agents export structured logs, latency metrics, and trace contexts asynchronously to centralized Google Operations endpoints.

nodes.label: App Microservice Pod
nodes.detail: Microservice instrumented with OpenTelemetry SDK; injects traceparent header.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry Collector
nodes.detail: Batches metrics, logs, and spans; flushes asynchronously over gRPC to Google APIs.

nodes.label: Cloud Logging Log Router
nodes.detail: Routes structured JSON logs to _Default bucket, BigQuery long-term sink, and Pub/Sub.

nodes.label: Cloud Trace Distributed Spans
nodes.detail: Visualizes end-to-end multi-hop latency waterfalls across microservices.

nodes.label: Cloud Monitoring (MQL)
nodes.detail: Evaluates p99 latency queries and triggers PagerDuty alerts on error budget burn.

nodes.label: Cloud Profiler (Continuous)
nodes.detail: Low-overhead continuous profiling identifying exact CPU and memory memory leaks.

steps.title: Asynchronous Telemetry Ingestion
steps.action: Microservice flushes metrics, logs, and trace spans to OpenTelemetry collector.
steps.why_traversal: Asynchronous batching introduces zero latency into customer transaction paths.

steps.title: Log Routing & Filtering
steps.action: Log Router extracts error metrics and routes compliance logs to BigQuery.
steps.why_traversal: Exclusion filters prevent storing noisy debug logs, saving 80% on logging bills.

steps.title: Distributed Trace Analysis
steps.action: Cloud Trace correlates spans with TraceID; identifies 1,800ms bottleneck in database query.
steps.why_traversal: Pinpoints exact microservice causing latency degradation across complex meshes.

steps.title: Continuous Profiling
steps.action: Cloud Profiler captures CPU flame graph, highlighting inefficient regex in production code.
steps.why_traversal: Less than 1% CPU overhead enables safe continuous profiling directly in production.

scenarios.label: Debug Log Ingestion Explosion
scenarios.root_cause: Developer left DEBUG logging enabled in 500 pods; generated 50TB logs/day.
scenarios.diverted_path: Monthly logging costs spike by $25,000 within 48 hours.
scenarios.blast_radius: Severe billing overrun; log router throttles non-critical projects.
scenarios.recovery: Create exclusion filter in Log Router to drop severity < INFO; set up log volume alerts.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Visualizes Google Cloud Observability architecture: details OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Cloud Monitoring MQL metrics, Cloud Logging log routing sinks, Cloud Trace distributed spans, and Cloud Profiler continuous CPU/heap profiling.
